comment: Specs stay INCLUDED here on purpose, so `check` type-checks them; only
`tsconfig.build.json` drops them, because `files` publishes `lib/` and an
emitted spec would ship. The test ENTRY is excluded from both: it is
compiled by the test task, which resolves `@gjsify/unit` for it.
`DOM` is in `lib` for `src/client/`, the only tree that runs in a browser;
it is bundled by `build:client`, never emitted into `lib/*.js` as a module.
